scenes.onScreenText: Why does gold move when yields move?
scenes.visual: REX tilts head at a glowing teal line chart (abstract, no numbers).

scenes.onScreenText: Gold pays no interest. Bonds do.
scenes.visual: Split frame: gold bar icon vs bond certificate icon.

scenes.onScreenText: When yields rise, holding gold costs more in what you give up. When they ease, that pressure fades.
scenes.visual: Seesaw animation: yields up, gold side lifts; reversed.

scenes.onScreenText: Last Friday: yields eased, gold bounced. That is a link, not a guarantee.
scenes.visual: Two simple arrows, no price levels.

scenes.onScreenText: CPI is Wednesday, 15:30 IST. Follow FOXREX.
